Zoe Papadakis | Data Scientist, HealthInsight Analytics  
Driven by curiosity and collaboration, I bridge complex health data with actionable insights. With a focus on improving patient outcomes through analytics, I leverage Python, SQL, and statistical modeling to solve real-world challenges.  

My work centers on transforming raw data into strategies that support clinical decision-making. Using Pandas and NumPy, I’ve streamlined data pipelines, reducing processing time by 30% in a recent project tracking chronic disease trends. Feature engineering and exploratory analysis have been key in refining predictive models—most notably, a scikit-learn-based system that improved early diagnosis accuracy by 15%.  

I thrive in environments where data meets impact. Whether crafting visualizations in Tableau to communicate findings or designing REST APIs to integrate health records, I prioritize clarity and scalability. My goal? To ensure every insight contributes to better care.  

Collaboration is central to my approach. I work closely with clinicians and engineers to align technical solutions with operational needs. While the path isn’t always straightforward, the reward of turning data into meaningful change keeps me motivated.  

Looking ahead, I’m excited to explore how emerging technologies can further enhance healthcare analytics. Let’s connect if you’re navigating similar challenges—there’s always value in sharing perspectives.
